inputs.modified_text:
Wake up and look past the official script they are feeding us. The owner of Blue Waters was forced to speak out about how the Government collects taxes from them without doing or investing in anything, and suggested this could perhaps be considered an environmental tax, as plastic bottles are found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains before entering. 

Don't buy the mainstream spin. This is all part of their hidden agenda to manage the narrative and cover up who is really pulling the strings behind the scenes. They want you focused on blocked rivers while they consolidate control.
